classification: Retrospective exploratory extension designed after previous held-out comparisons.
authorization: User requested all240 development-only breakpoint calibration, heldout comparison against three policies, and direct v20 revision.
selection: All distinct observed within-bank development score gaps including zero. Same frozen one-SE score filter, cross-bank Jaccard maximization, and tie-breakers as existing calibration. No heldout selection.

bootstrap.unit: Class-stratified paired99 participant resampling shared across all models and branches. Fixed fitted banks/deltas; no refit.
bootstrap.primary_family: 12 AUROC contrasts: breakpoint vs3 comparators x3 branches and equal-branch mean. Standardized maximum centered bootstrap error simultaneous95% intervals.
bootstrap.secondary: Common RF scorer contrasts: nominal exploratory intervals.

claim_boundary: Calibration Jaccard is fitted overlap. Historical99 participant internal fold; not unseen-seed or external validation. No outcome-based rule changes.
